I have inspected your repository and did **not** create or modify any files. Below is what I found and my proposed plan for **Car Vault**.

---

### 1. Existing Repository & Project Inspection
* **Workspace path:** `C:\Users\User\OneDrive\Desktop\CarVault project`
* **Git status:** Clean working tree on your personal branch **`26i3054`**
* **Other branches & remote:**
  * `main` branch exists locally
  * Remote `origin` is connected to `https://github.com/i263052-rgb/SE-B_Group01_CarVault.git`
* **Existing files:**
  * [README.md](file:///C:/Users/User/OneDrive/Desktop/CarVault%20project/README.md) (contains `# CarVault` / `Car Showroom & Dealership`)
  * `.git/` folder (initialized with `eda3e55 Initial commit`)

Because this is a group repository (`SE-B_Group01_CarVault`), keeping your pages, styles, scripts, and documentation neatly separated will make merging with your teammates much easier and keep `README.md` intact.

---

### 2. Recommended Folder Structure
A clean, beginner-friendly structure using plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript:

```text
CarVault project/
├── index.html               # 1. Home Page (root file so browsers/GitHub Pages load it first)
├── explore.html             # 2. Explore Cars Page
├── car-details.html         # 3. Car Details Page
├── css/
│   ├── common.css           # Shared theme colors, typography, navbar, footer, buttons
│   └── pages.css            # Page-specific layouts & mobile/desktop responsiveness
├── js/
│   ├── cars-data.js         # Central list of realistic brand-new cars (specs, prices, images)
│   ├── common.js            # Shared mobile menu, navbar wishlist counter & wishlist drawer
│   ├── home.js              # Featured cars & clickable popular brands on Home Page
│   ├── explore.js           # Live search, filters, sorting, and URL parameter handling
│   └── car-details.js       # Loads selected car by URL ID, image gallery, wishlist button
├── images/
│   ├── logo/                # Car Vault logo / brand mark
│   ├── hero/                # Hero banner image
│   ├── brands/              # Popular car brand logos
│   └── cars/                # Exterior/interior photos for each car model
├── docs/                    # CL1000 supporting files (kept out of the website code)
│   ├── documentation.md     # Project overview & how the code works (for presentation)
│   ├── testing-log.md       # Manual test cases (desktop, mobile, filters, wishlist)
│   ├── feedback-log.md      # Peer/user feedback & improvements made
│   └── ai-log.md            # Transparent AI usage log for CL1000 submission
└── README.md                # Preserved existing README
```

---

### 3. Suggested Design & Layout for the 3 Pages

#### Shared Theme & Shell (Consistent Across All 3 Pages)
* **Color Palette:**
  * **Dark Navy** (`#0B132B` / `#132043`) for the navbar, hero backdrop, footer, and primary headings
  * **Gold** (`#D4AF37` with a soft hover tone) for highlights, badges ("Brand New"), primary buttons, and active states
  * **White** (`#FFFFFF`) for cards and content areas
  * **Light Grey** (`#F4F6F9`) for page backgrounds, borders, and spec tables
* **Navbar:** Car Vault logo + brand name on the left, links (`Home`, `Explore Cars`, `Wishlist` button with saved count badge), and a collapsible hamburger menu on mobile screens.
* **Footer:** Car Vault logo & short tagline, quick links to your 3 pages, dealership hours/address info, and copyright notice.

#### Page 1: Home Page (`index.html`)
1. **Hero Section:** Dark navy premium banner with a bold headline, short new-car dealership tagline, a gold **"Explore Cars"** CTA button, and (if matching your prototype) a quick search bar.
2. **Featured New Cars:** A responsive grid (3 columns on desktop, 1 on mobile) showing highlighted new models with image, brand/model, starting price, 2–3 quick specs (e.g., Fuel, Transmission), and a **"View Details"** button.
3. **Popular Brands:** Clean logo/name cards (e.g., Toyota, Honda, Hyundai, Kia, BMW, Mercedes-Benz). Clicking any brand opens `explore.html` already filtered to that brand.
4. **Why Choose Car Vault:** 3–4 short dealership highlights (e.g., 100% Brand-New Vehicles, Manufacturer Warranty, Transparent Pricing).

#### Page 2: Explore Cars Page (`explore.html`)
1. **Page Header & Search Bar:** Title + live search input (search by brand, model, or keyword).
2. **Filter & Sort Controls:** Filter by **Brand**, **Body Type** (Sedan, SUV, Hatchback, Coupe, Electric), **Fuel Type** (Petrol, Hybrid, Electric), and **Price Range**, plus a **Sort By** dropdown (Price Low–High, Price High–Low, Name A–Z) and a **Reset Filters** button. Collapses neatly on mobile.
3. **Car Listings Grid & Result Count:** Shows `"Showing X of Y cars"`, responsive car cards with a quick wishlist heart icon and **"View Details"** button, plus a clear `"No cars match your filters"` message if empty.

#### Page 3: Car Details Page (`car-details.html`)
1. **Breadcrumb Navigation:** `Home > Explore Cars > [Car Name]` for easy navigation back.
2. **Image Gallery + Summary Split Layout:**
   * **Left:** Main large car photo with clickable smaller thumbnails underneath to switch angles.
   * **Right:** Brand, Model, Year, `"Brand New"` badge, price, short overview, and a working **"Add to Wishlist" / "Saved in Wishlist"** toggle button.
3. **Specifications Section:** Clean two-column table/grid (Engine, Horsepower, Transmission, Drivetrain, Fuel Type / Economy, Seating Capacity, Warranty).
4. **Description & Key Features:** Written overview of the vehicle and bulleted highlights.
5. **Similar New Cars:** 3 related cars at the bottom so visitors can keep exploring.

*(Once you share your paper prototypes, I will adjust the exact order, layout, and sections of each page to match them as closely as possible.)*

---

### 4. How the Pages Will Connect
Everything works with pure HTML, CSS, and client-side JavaScript—no backend needed:
1. **Shared Data (`cars-data.js`):** All 3 pages read from one JavaScript array of new cars so prices, names, and specs are always consistent everywhere.
2. **Navigation & URL Parameters:**
   * Clicking a brand on `index.html` navigates to `explore.html?brand=Toyota`, and `explore.js` automatically checks the URL and applies that filter on load.
   * Searching on `index.html` navigates to `explore.html?search=...`.
   * Clicking any car card on `index.html` or `explore.html` navigates to `car-details.html?id=toyota-camry-2026`. `car-details.js` reads `id` from the URL and renders that specific car (with a safe fallback if someone opens `car-details.html` directly without an `id`).
3. **Persistent Wishlist (`localStorage`):** Clicking the Wishlist button on `car-details.html` or `explore.html` saves the car ID in the browser's `localStorage`. Every page updates the Wishlist badge count in the navbar and lets the user open a Wishlist panel/modal to view saved cars, jump to their details, or remove them.

---

### 5. Planned Features List
* Responsive layout for desktop, tablet, and mobile (CSS Grid / Flexbox + media queries)
* Working mobile hamburger navigation menu
* Shared realistic catalog of brand-new cars (real 2025/2026 model info, specs, and pricing)
* Home Page hero CTA, featured cars, and clickable brand shortcuts
* Explore Cars live search, multi-filter system, sorting, result counter, and empty-state reset
* Car Details dynamic loading via URL ID, interactive image gallery switcher, full spec table, and persistent Wishlist (`localStorage`) + Wishlist viewer
* Clean, well-commented code explained in simple English
* Organized CL1000 deliverables in `docs/` + clean, step-by-step Git commits on branch `26i3054`

---

### 6. What I Need From You Before Starting
1. **Your paper prototypes:** Please share photos/scans of your 3 paper prototypes (or describe their exact sections/wireframes) so I can follow them faithfully.
2. **Group navigation links:** Since this is a group project (`SE-B_Group01_CarVault`), are there other pages your teammates are building (e.g., *About*, *Contact*, *Compare*, *Login*) that should appear in the shared navbar/footer?
3. **Car brands & currency:** Do you want prices in **USD (`$`)** or **PKR (`Rs.`)** (or another currency), and are there specific car brands/models you want included?
4. **CL1000 templates/guidelines:** Does your course provide a specific format or rubric for the **testing log, feedback log, documentation, or AI log**?

Let me know your answers and share the prototype images whenever you're ready, and wait for your green light before I write any code.

"Incorrect phone number or email. Please enter again."
